The middle lighter is open, showing the metal windguard and nozzle, with a similar blue body and yellow/purple feather design. The right lighter is closed, appearing as a solid purple rectangular block.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The feather pattern appears slightly 'painted on' or digitally smeared rather than having the crisp edges of a high-quality print or decal. The colors blend into the plastic texture unnaturally.

artifact_observations.location: Top metal assembly of the middle lighter
artifact_observations.reasoning: The holes in the metal windguard are slightly irregular and non-uniform, lacking the precise mechanical symmetry expected of mass-produced metal parts. The connection between the metal top and plastic body has slight edge bleeding.
The rightmost lighter appears slightly warped; the vertical lines are not perfectly straight, suggesting minor geometric instability common in AI generation.
